integrity: Explicit gapwise bijections prove all finite-square fibers. Formal power-series decomposition and algebraic singularity transfer prove the limit law. Source inspections and remaining priority risks are stated in the review.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for order-preserving extensive partial injections of finite chains; no claim is made for arbitrary transformations. The unweighted sequence and its scalar asymptotics are known as OEIS A005773. Finite replay is not a substitute for the universal bijective and asymptotic proofs. A 1992 thesis and 2015 paper leave a residual literature-priority risk.
title: Motzkin square-root fibers and a Rayleigh fixed-point law in injective partial Catalan monoids
